offers_products.reason: Publishes newspapers, books (HarperCollins) and digital news products like The Wall Street Journal, The Times, New York Post.

offers_services.reason: Dow Jones professional information services, subscriptions, digital real estate listings (REA Group) and advertising services are major offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Readers buy newspaper and digital subscriptions; HarperCollins books sold to consumers; real estate portal users.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers, Dow Jones professional customers, and retailers buying HarperCollins books are organizational buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscriptions to WSJ, Times and Dow Jones, plus repeat advertising and book sales to retailers, dominate revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising and real estate listings revenue fall in downturns, though subscriptions are steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Subscriptions, books, newspapers and ads are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from content products, subscriptions and digital platforms rather than billed staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual readers and book buyers, plus many advertisers; not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Mainly content publishing and digital platforms; some printing plants but not heavy investment relative to the business.

notes: Based on general knowledge of News Corp's segments (Dow Jones, Digital Real Estate, Book Publishing, News Media); the website text was brief.
